verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report of eBay running a 2-region, fully replicated ClickHouse system. That shows ClickHouse itself can replicate data across regions, but nothing documents placing data or replicas near users to cut read latency. missing for 10: first-party docs on multi-region replication or region selection (self-hosted or Cloud), latency-oriented geo-placement or read routing, and hands-on evidence of lower worldwide read latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can place data or replicas in regions close to my users to keep read latency low worldwide

citations.quote: a 2-region fully replicated ClickHouse system of 40 nodes
